name: Gojo
tagline: A weekend is enough for the useful part: a notch panel with clipboard history, a file shelf, music controls, window snapping, and screen warmth. Getting it ready for daily use takes longer because macOS permissions, dictation, multiple displays, and tiny UI details add up fast.
verdictSummary: KINDA: Gojo costs $4.99/mo ($59.88/yr). Here is the practical trade-off and what you lose.
